parse clauses/match-where/MatchWhere6.feature [2] setup
      CREATE (s:Single), (a:A {num: 42}),
             (b:B {num: 46}), (c:C)
      CREATE (s)-[:REL]->(a),
             (s)-[:REL]->(b),
             (a)-[:REL]->(c),
             (b)-[:LOOP]->(b)
---
parse clauses/match-where/MatchWhere6.feature [2] query
      MATCH (n:Single)
      OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r]-(m)
      WHERE m:NonExistent
      RETURN r
---
parse clauses/match-where/MatchWhere6.feature [4] setup
      CREATE (a), (b {name: 'Mark'})
      CREATE (a)-[:T]->(b)
---
parse clauses/match-where/MatchWhere6.feature [4] query
      MATCH (n)-->(x0)
      OPTIONAL MATCH (x0)-->(x1)
      WHERE x1.name = 'bar'
      RETURN x0.name
---
parse clauses/with/With6.feature [1] setup

             ({name: 'A'}),

---
parse clauses/with/With6.feature [1] query
      MATCH (a)
      WITH a.name AS name, count(*) AS relCount
      RETURN name, relCount
---
parse clauses/with/With6.feature [2] setup
      CREATE ()-[:T1]->(:X),
             ()-[:T2]->(:X),
             ()-[:T3]->()
---
parse clauses/with/With6.feature [2] query
      MATCH ()-[r1]->(:X)
      WITH r1 AS r2, count(*) AS c
      MATCH ()-[r2]->()
      RETURN r2 AS rel
---
parse clauses/with/With6.feature [3] setup
      CREATE ()-[:T1]->(:X),
             ()-[:T2]->(:X),
             ()-[:T3]->()
---
parse clauses/with/With6.feature [3] query
      MATCH (a)-[r1]->(b:X)
      WITH a, r1 AS r2, b, count(*) AS c
      MATCH (a)-[r2]->(b)
      RETURN r2 AS rel
